title: Employee bonus classification
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on employees(id, name, salary).
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT name, CASE WHEN salary >= 80000 THEN 'High' WHEN salary >= 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS bonus_tier FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC

validation.setup_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INT, name VARCHAR(50), salary INT); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1, 'Alice', 90000), (2, 'Bob', 40000), (3, 'Charlie', 60000), (4, 'David', 80000);
